opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority. If applicable, should have at least a ‘Good’ rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We support organisations working with disability. Grants to capital projects (new building, refurbishment, equipment) that help people live more independently, focusing on training, employment and supported housing, especially for young people transitioning from children’s services to adult services.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority. If applicable, should have at least a ‘Good’ rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We provide funding for charities working in mental health, awarding grants towards capital projects with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority. If applicable, should have at least a ‘Good’ rating from a regulator such as CQC. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We support organisations providing care and services for older people, especially those with neurodegenerative conditions or isolation, awarding grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority operating a site of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, open to the public. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We support organisations managing historic sites, awarding grants for conservation, restoration, interpretation and education spaces, with emphasis on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or hospice operating within the NHS. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We support hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care, awarding grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority, fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We support libraries and archives with nationally significant collections, awarding grants for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We provide funding for museums and galleries to improve display and interpretation of nationally significant collections, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries and education spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority, primarily focused on professional performance and training/education. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We fund performing arts organisations to improve training and education facilities, generally for building or refurbishment of such facilities and occasionally specialist equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity, local authority or university with scientific or natural history collections of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We support organisations with significant scientific or natural history collections to improve public engagement with science through history of science projects, awarding grants for new or refurbished galleries and education spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: State‑funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK.
opportunities.summary: We support high‑achieving state‑funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges to improve specialist teaching spaces and equipment for subjects such as science, design & technology, art, languages, music and performing arts.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority with a ‘Good’ regulator rating. UK only.
opportunities.summary: We support special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, awarding grants for new buildings, refurbishment or equipment that develop skills for employment or independent living.

opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university or research institution. Must be able to demonstrate a capital shortfall of at least £25,000 on a project costing at least £50,000.
opportunities.summary: We fund capital projects at universities and research institutions, including new build, refurbishment or equipment, to support research and teaching infrastructure.
